explanation.headline: FDA records show the product is manufactured at a plant with VAI inspections through 2023-11-10; no OAI classification appears in the provided records

sentences.text: The milrinone lactate used at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside shares NDC 71288020011 and labeler Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc., and its SPL set ID 6c6b69f9 identifies Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (FEI 3010625707) as the manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection records for that plant show three VAI classifications: inspection 937313 ending 2015-05-12, inspection 1048084 ending 2018-04-03, and inspection 1224895 ending 2023-11-10.
No OAI classification or other enforcement action appears in the supplied FDA records for this facility.
Corvale General holds 158 units with 6.0 daily use (26 days on hand) and Corvale Lakeside holds 13 units with 1.6 daily use (8 days on hand).
Corvale East holds a different package size (NDC 71288020050) with 75 units and 5.1 daily use (15 days on hand).

Because the links between the shortage and any specific FDA finding are weak or absent in the provided data, verify current allocation status with Meitheal and check FDA's drug shortage database for any posted shortage reason.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-3b2944.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%milrinone%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%milrinone%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-f21e84.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('6c6b69f9-e229-4a93-a108-9eafdab614f0') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-99c9b3.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%milrinone%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-31b011.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%milrinone%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-d76025.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%milrinone%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-bc911b.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3010625707', '3005035920', '3008461619', '3002647489', '3006704412') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-c38f78.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3010625707') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('nanjing king friend biochemical')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-16c9fa.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('nanjing king friend biochemical', 'meitheal') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%milrinone%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-d84107.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('71288020050', '71288020011')
